Stop building brittle toy chatbots: Anthropic's new reference architecture provides production-ready blueprints for consumer shopping agents and back-office merchant agents. 🛒🤖

If you are an AI engineer or full-stack developer trying to bridge Large Language Models with complex retail domains, you know how painful it is to build reliable search, cart management, and safe backend writes from scratch. 

Anthropic just dropped `anthropics/commerce-agents` to solve exactly this, giving you a production-grade structural blueprint for real-world e-commerce applications.

✨ Key Features:
• Dual-Agent Architecture: Separates concerns between customer-facing discovery/checkout flows and back-office merchant operations (analytics, listings, pricing).
• Multi-Runtime Flexibility: Runs natively across three execution paradigms—Anthropic Messages API, the Claude Agent SDK, and Managed Agents via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
• Built-in Safety & Fencing: Implements strict provenance gates, memory validation, and a human-in-the-loop approval workflow where every merchant write is staged rather than executed directly.
• Cross-Vertical Scaffolding: Includes fully runnable vertical implementations (Retail, Travel, Telecom, Entertainment) alongside a Claude Code plugin for fast custom project generation.

Whether you are embedding an intelligent shopping assistant into a consumer mobile app or building an internal back-office copilot that helps merchants safely analyze sales data and stage inventory updates, this repository gives you the secure foundation you need.

👉 Check out the repo and start building: https://github.com/anthropics/commerce-agents

Ever tried rendering 2,234 individual 3D anatomical meshes in a browser without completely tanking your framerate? 💀

Most developers building complex 3D web apps hit a massive brick wall when trying to handle massive, highly detailed scientific datasets. Thousands of separate draw calls bring standard web renderers to a grinding halt.

Enter human-atlas—a high-performance React and Three.js explorer that lets you navigate the entire BodyParts3D adult male reference model right in your browser. 

This repository is an absolute masterclass in web-based 3D optimization. Here is how it solves the performance bottleneck:

⚡ GPU-Powered Optimization: Merges geometry into batches and utilizes per-structure GPU textures for translation, visibility, and selection to bypass thousands of expensive draw calls.
🧠 Granular Control: Features 2,234 individually selectable meshes, 15 anatomical systems, 3,432 named concepts, and dynamic exploded view layouts managing over 2.2 million triangles smoothly.
📱 Multi-Device Ready: Comes with rigorous validation scripts for clean UI separation across desktop and mobile touch controls, exploded inventories, and detail panels.
🤖 WebMCP Integration: Exposes advanced anatomy search and inspection capabilities directly inside compatible browsers.

Whether you are building EdTech software, medical training tools, patient consultation apps, or looking for a bulletproof architectural pattern for web-based CAD and digital twins, this is a blueprint you need to study.

Explore the source code and run it yourself:
https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas

Stop getting blindsided by sudden rate limits: Codenotch is a slick macOS utility that pins real-time usage metrics for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more directly to your screen edge.

Juggling multiple AI coding tools with strict, opaque rate limits is painful. Instead of manually checking various dashboards or editor panels, Codenotch gives developers a unified, always-on visual indicator on any screen edge that tracks live usage limits, reset windows, and active session states across multiple AI providers.

Here is why you need it in your daily workflow:
- Zero-Sign-In Credential Borrowing: Safely reads existing signed-in sessions, local SQLite state, keychain items, and config files directly from tools already installed on your Mac without requiring independent authentication.
- Hardware and Dock Integration: Automatically wraps around a physical MacBook camera notch if placed at the top, or docks dynamically against the macOS Dock if placed at the bottom, supporting all four screen edges.
- Multi-Account Isolation: Automatically discovers and separates distinct configuration profiles (such as parallel personal and work environments) into individual, dedicated indicator rings.
- Robust Fault Tolerance: Gracefully handles aggressive API rate limits by persisting back-off deadlines, degrading unverified limits to explicit visual states, and cutting polling intervals when idle.

Avoid unexpected productivity interruptions during heavy refactoring sprints by monitoring usage limits in your peripheral vision without context-switching. 

Check out the source code and try it out here:
https://github.com/vinzdg/codenotch

🚀 Turn your siloed WeChat chat history into a local, searchable personal intelligence network complete with daily executive briefings and actionable business opportunity tracking!

We all struggle to extract actionable business insights, unfulfilled commitments, and relationship signals from heavily siloed, encrypted local messaging apps. Doing this usually requires risky workarounds or third-party cloud services that compromise your privacy.

Wechat Intelligence Hub solves this securely and completely on-device without relying on cloud services or bypassing user consent.

✨ Notable Features:
• Clean-room, read-only local reader core (rion-wechat-reader) that interfaces directly with local database files, SQLCipher, and Zstandard compression without hooks or injections.
• Deterministic local intelligence engine that aggregates contacts, group chat topics, pending replies, promises, and commercial leads into structured data.
• Dual-format reporting outputs generating both Markdown for AI processing and an interactive HTML dashboard featuring global search, multi-tab filtering, and radar views.
• Agent-friendly architecture via standalone CLI tools (wechat-cli) and integration skills designed to be operated safely through AI coding assistants like Codex.

💡 Developer Value: 
Gain a clean architectural blueprint for building local-first, privacy-respecting data extraction pipelines that interface with complex native application databases. It demonstrates how to safely bridge local encrypted storage (SQLCipher) with LLM agents via constrained, read-only CLI interfaces and structured prompt contexts.

Whether you want to automate daily executive briefings or build local-first RAG systems over your chat archives, this repository is built for your workflow.

👉 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/Rion-Wu-tech/wechat-intelligence-hub

Skip the expensive SaaS subscriptions and run your own open-source AI video repurposing pipeline to automatically turn long YouTube videos into viral 9:16 shorts. 🚀

Are you tired of paying high monthly fees for video clipping tools like OpusClip? 

pierrenade/short-video-generator-AI automates the end-to-end conversion of long-form YouTube videos or local video files into viral short-form clips (9:16) by combining local speech transcription, LLM-based highlight detection, smart deduplication, and automated vertical cropping. 🎬🔥

Built for Python developers, content creators, AI hobbyists, and indie hackers, this modular codebase lets you build custom video automation workflows completely free of paid third-party dependencies. 

Key Features:
🎙️ Local Transcription via faster-whisper: Generates highly accurate, timestamped transcripts locally with support for hardware acceleration (CPU/CUDA) and multiple languages.
🧠 LLM-Powered Virality Ranking: Uses configurable LLM providers (OpenAI, Gemini, MuAPI) to classify video content types and rank moments on a 0–100 scale using a comprehensive virality framework.
🎯 Context-Aware AI Hooks: Automatically generates and prepends engaging context-aware hook lines at the start of rendered clips to boost viewer retention.
💻 Dual Interface (CLI & Web UI): Provides both a command-line interface for scriptable automation and a local web server interface for queuing multiple videos visually.

Whether you are building a custom automated social media agency tool that ingests daily podcasts and outputs TikTok and Reels clips, or creating an internal content repurposing microservice for marketing teams, this repo gives you full programmatic control via a clean Python architecture.

Check out the repository and start building your own AI video pipeline today:
https://github.com/pierrenade/short-video-generator-AI
